# Diagnostic Tools

Step-by-step introduction into the possibilities of Trace DQL queries.

input.value:
fetch spans 
| filter span.name == "POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem" OR span.name == "oteldemo.CartService/GetCart" OR endpoint.name == "/api/checkout" OR span.name == "oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge"
| summarize count(), by:{span.name}
| sort `count()` desc

fetch spans 
| filter span.name == "POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem" OR span.name == "oteldemo.CartService/GetCart" OR endpoint.name == "/api/checkout" OR span.name == "oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge"
| summarize count(), by:{span.name}
| sort `count()` desc

grail.canonicalQuery:
fetch spans
| filter span.name == "POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem" OR span.name == "oteldemo.CartService/GetCart" OR endpoint.name == "/api/checkout" OR span.name == "oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge"
| summarize by:{span.name}, count()
| sort `count()` desc
grail.query:
fetch spans 
| filter span.name == "POST /oteldemo.CartService/AddItem" OR span.name == "oteldemo.CartService/GetCart" OR endpoint.name == "/api/checkout" OR span.name == "oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge"
| summarize count(), by:{span.name}
| sort `count()` desc

grail.canonicalQuery:
fetch spans, from:-30m, samplingRatio:1, scanLimitGBytes:50
| filter request.is_root_span == TRUE
| filter request.is_failed
| fieldsAdd sampling.probability = (power(2, 56) - coalesce(sampling.threshold, 0)) * power(2, -56), sampling.multiplicity = 1 / sampling.probability, multiplicity = coalesce(sampling.multiplicity, 1) * coalesce(aggregation.count, 1) * dt.system.sampling_ratio
| fieldsAdd request.status_code = if(request.is_failed, "Failure", else:"Success")
| fieldsAdd aggregation.duration_avg = coalesce(aggregation.duration_sum / aggregation.count, duration)
| fieldsAdd dt.entity.service.entity.name = entityAttr(dt.entity.service, "entity.name")
| summarize by:{dt.entity.service.entity.name}, {dt.entity.service = takeFirst(dt.entity.service), avg_duration = sum(aggregation.duration_avg * multiplicity) / sum(multiplicity), duration_p90 = percentile(duration, 90), duration_p95 = percentile(duration, 95), duration_p99 = percentile(duration, 99), count = sum(multiplicity), failed = sum(if(request.status_code == "Failure", multiplicity, else:0)), failure_rate = round(toDouble(sum(if(request.status_code == "Failure", multiplicity, else:0)) / sum(multiplicity)), decimals:3)}
| fieldsAdd level = 0
| append 
	[
		fetch spans, from:-30m, samplingRatio:1, scanLimitGBytes:50
		| filter request.is_root_span == TRUE
		| filter request.is_failed
		| fieldsAdd sampling.probability = (power(2, 56) - coalesce(sampling.threshold, 0)) * power(2, -56), sampling.multiplicity = 1 / sampling.probability, multiplicity = coalesce(sampling.multiplicity, 1) * coalesce(aggregation.count, 1) * dt.system.sampling_ratio
		| fieldsAdd request.status_code = if(request.is_failed, "Failure", else:"Success")
		| fieldsAdd aggregation.duration_avg = coalesce(aggregation.duration_sum / aggregation.count, duration)
		| fieldsAdd dt.entity.service.entity.name = entityAttr(dt.entity.service, "entity.name")
		| summarize by:{dt.entity.service.entity.name, k8s.pod.name}, {dt.entity.service = takeFirst(dt.entity.service), dt.entity.cloud_application_instance = takeFirst(dt.entity.cloud_application_instance), avg_duration = sum(aggregation.duration_avg * multiplicity) / sum(multiplicity), duration_p90 = percentile(duration, 90), duration_p95 = percentile(duration, 95), duration_p99 = percentile(duration, 99), count = sum(multiplicity), failed = sum(if(request.status_code == "Failure", multiplicity, else:0)), failure_rate = round(toDouble(sum(if(request.status_code == "Failure", multiplicity, else:0)) / sum(multiplicity)), decimals:3)}
		| fieldsAdd level = 1
	]
| append 
	[
		fetch spans, from:-30m, samplingRatio:1, scanLimitGBytes:50
		| filter request.is_root_span == TRUE
		| filter request.is_failed
		| fieldsAdd sampling.probability = (power(2, 56) - coalesce(sampling.threshold, 0)) * power(2, -56), sampling.multiplicity = 1 / sampling.probability, multiplicity = coalesce(sampling.multiplicity, 1) * coalesce(aggregation.count, 1) * dt.system.sampling_ratio
		| fieldsAdd request.status_code = if(request.is_failed, "Failure", else:"Success")
		| fieldsAdd aggregation.duration_avg = coalesce(aggregation.duration_sum / aggregation.count, duration)
		| fieldsAdd dt.entity.service.entity.name = entityAttr(dt.entity.service, "entity.name")
		| summarize by:{dt.entity.service.entity.name, k8s.pod.name, endpoint.name}, {dt.entity.service = takeFirst(dt.entity.service), dt.entity.cloud_application_instance = takeFirst(dt.entity.cloud_application_instance), avg_duration = sum(aggregation.duration_avg * multiplicity) / sum(multiplicity), duration_p90 = percentile(duration, 90), duration_p95 = percentile(duration, 95), duration_p99 = percentile(duration, 99), count = sum(multiplicity), failed = sum(if(request.status_code == "Failure", multiplicity, else:0)), failure_rate = round(toDouble(sum(if(request.status_code == "Failure", multiplicity, else:0)) / sum(multiplicity)), decimals:3)}
		| fieldsAdd level = 2
	]

grail.canonicalQuery:
fetch spans, from:-30m, scanLimitGBytes:500
| filter request.is_root_span == TRUE
| filter endpoint.name == "/api/checkout"
| limit 1000
| fieldsAdd request.status_code = if(request.is_failed, "Failure", else:"Success")
| fieldsAdd span.source = if(isNotNull(dt.agent.module.id), "OneAgent", else:"OpenTelemetry")
| fieldsAdd http.response.status_code = coalesce(http.response.status_code, toLong(http.status_code))
| fieldsAdd dt.entity.service.entity.name = entityAttr(dt.entity.service, "entity.name"), dt.entity.process_group.entity.name = entityAttr(dt.entity.process_group, "entity.name")
| fieldsAdd http.request.header.cookie
